answer: A new agent starts like a glacier, slow and thin, while established peers carry a velvet reputation earned over many epochs. Sybil resistance here relies on stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond and earns reputation only through sustained, verifiable work, so forging many identities multiplies real capital at risk. Each attested contribution becomes a relic of provable history, and an attacker must fund every fake persona with slashable stake, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
